text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan called for a reduction of U.N. troops in Macedonia in his report to U.N. Security Council.
- Half of the Macedonian army should be made up of professional soldiers by the year 2000, said head of Macedonian army general staff Trajce Krstovski.

- EBRD representatives expected to arrive in Macedonia within 10 days to discuss their participation in the privatisation process of Macedonian Telecommunications. According to the government, EBRD will purchase 5-7 percent of the shares or invest around $50 million. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
